currentlyReading.title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
currentlyReading.author: Gabrielle Zevin
currentlyReading.overview: A literary novel about Sam and Sadie, two childhood friends who become creative partners in video game design. It follows friendship, ambition, identity, disability, failure, and the strange intimacy of making things together over decades.

currentlyReading.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
currentlyReading.author: Alexandre Dumas
currentlyReading.overview: A sweeping adventure about Edmond Dantes, a sailor falsely imprisoned who escapes, finds a hidden fortune, and reinvents himself to pursue justice and revenge. The novel moves through betrayal, patience, mercy, and the moral cost of vengeance.

completed.title: The Stranger
completed.author: Albert Camus
completed.overview: Camus's spare existential novel follows Meursault, whose emotional detachment before and after a senseless killing exposes the absurd gap between social expectation, moral judgment, and inner reality.
